headline: Bernanke recalls *18.5%* mortgage rates
quote: the mortgage rate for a 30-year mortgage was 18.5 percent
title: Fed Chair Bernanke: Mortgage rates reached 18.5 percent in the 1980s
caption: Ben Bernanke recalled his personal experience shopping for a home in the early 1980s during Paul Volcker's tenure at the Fed. Severe rate hikes pushed 30-year fixed mortgage rates to 18.5% to suppress high inflation.
comment: How would an 18.5% mortgage rate impact today's housing market?
